name: Degradatsiya: Novoye Nachalo
source:
Hot summer, sand, jungles, palm trees - isn't it wonderful for Sovyonok? In this story, our protagonists head to school to study, but due to some adventures, they end up in a beautiful, sunny pioneer camp with tropical forests and an amazing crowd!

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2179806221]Steam[/url]]
